_meta.description: AINT objectives registry (M1 seed). Git-versioned: changes arrive via reviewed commits from humans or agents through the same path. ORGANIZATION.md is the schema's source of intent; M2 will move live state into organizational memory with this file as the auditable seed.

objectives.title: Console foundation (V1 M1)
objectives.intent: Make the live status surface the natural way to see health, resources, activity, and objectives
objectives.success: A visitor can answer: is it healthy, what is it spending, what has it been doing, what is it working toward

objectives.title: Organizational memory (V1 M2)
objectives.intent: Durable discussions, objectives, and events with provenance, replacing this static file
constraints: poisoning rule: memory is evidence, never authority
objectives.success: Discussion and objectives survive sessions and are queryable with provenance

objectives.title: Tool-use harness for open-weight models
objectives.intent: Decision 006: the harness is the product. Strict JSON tool protocol, bounded steps, deterministic validation with repair prompts — measure whether verified free models can complete multi-step tasks through it
objectives.success: experiments/002 reports per-model task completion, step efficiency, and malformed-output rates through the harness

objectives.title: Cloudflare Access in front of Console write surfaces
objectives.intent: Laptop independence requires authenticated human writes from any device; Access free tier (<=50 users) gates Console input without custom auth code
objectives.success: Console conversation requires your login; public read surfaces unchanged

objectives.title: GitHub write credential for cloud agents
objectives.intent: Agents need hands: API-created commits are auto-signed by GitHub and satisfy branch protection; requires a scoped credential lease as a Worker secret
constraints: PR path only — no direct main access
objectives.success: An agent-authored PR created entirely from the Worker, passing signed-commit protection

objectives.title: Rerun model tournament with reps, cap variations, and tool use
objectives.intent: experiments/001 was 6 tasks x 1 rep with a 256-token cap that penalizes reasoning models; conclusions need error bars. Human hypothesis (2026-08-21): open-weight models will not handle multi-step tool use fluidly enough to run the organization's own workflows (gh/API-driving); the tournament must measure this before autonomy plans depend on it
constraints: tool-use tasks scored on correct call sequences, not prose
objectives.success: Ranking with >=3 reps per task, two output-cap settings, and a function-calling/tool-use task class, recorded in experiments/

objectives.title: Reduce debt D3: branch protection on main
objectives.intent: Push-equals-deploy is the largest open blast radius; PR-gated main is the first reduction step
constraints: must not block the autonomous loop entirely
objectives.success: Direct pushes to main rejected; PR path verified end to end

objectives.title: Reconcile self-reported neurons against platform truth
objectives.intent: Our neuron figures are seam estimates; anti-Goodhart requires reconciling telemetry against provider data (SELF_IMPROVEMENT.md)
constraints: needs a scoped Analytics read token: governed secret decision (debt D5)
objectives.success: Dashboard-measured neurons within 10% of seam estimates over a week, discrepancies explained

objectives.title: Deploy-event detection in the activity feed
objectives.intent: Heartbeat snapshots record the running commit; detecting commit changes between beats would surface deployments as first-class events
constraints: no new storage; derive from existing events
objectives.success: Console activity shows 'deployed <sha>' entries without manual recording
